Now it's 6%. Blacks went from 3% in the 70s to 13% in 2025. This was just put out. It's population by race in Texas from the 1970s to the 2025. Hispanics in the 1970s were 7%, and now they're 40%, followed by whites at 39%. 99%. What's interesting is a lot of people who are talking about this are saying Texas is fucked. What exactly does that mean? Because it's not white anymore? Or fully white? Or mainly white? Interesting. Okay.
